name: JokeAPI
tagline: Free multi-language joke API with category filters and blacklists
description: JokeAPI is a free public joke API that serves jokes in multiple languages with filtering by category, type, and blacklist flags. It supports no-key access for common client use, optional safe-mode filtering, and JSON responses suitable for bots, apps, and demos.

auth.details: No authentication required for standard public endpoints; requests work without an API key.

use_cases: fetch a random joke for a chatbot reply
get programming jokes with blacklist filters
list joke categories for a joke picker UI
fetch multi-language jokes for localization demos
